instruction: On the Apple Store iPhone 17 Pro page, configure the purchase options as follows: select the White (Silver) color, choose 1TB storage, set the payment option to Buy (not monthly installments), select AT&T as the carrier, do not add a trade-in, and do not add AppleCare. Then check the displayed price.

On the Apple Mac Studio purchase page, configure the options as follows: select the M4 Max chip with 16-core CPU and 40-core GPU, choose 64GB memory, choose 1TB storage, add a Final Cut Pro license, add a Logic Pro license, do not add a trade-in, and select Buy as the payment option. Then check the displayed total price.

On the Apple iPad 11-inch purchase page, configure the options as follows: select the White (Silver) color, choose 256GB storage, select Wi-Fi + Cellular connectivity, skip engraving, add an Apple Pencil (USB-C), add a Magic Keyboard Folio (US English), do not add a trade-in, select Buy as the payment option (no financing), and do not add AppleCare. Then check the displayed total price.
Starting from the Apple homepage, navigate to the Apple Music page and find the monthly price of the Individual plan.
Starting from the Apple iPad Accessories page, navigate to the Apple Pencil Pro product page and find its price.
